info.title: Vero API
info.description: Vero Cash: cash forecast, owner rules and simulated actions for small businesses.

get.description: The process is up. No dependencies are checked (used by liveness probes).
The demo state is loaded and requests can be served (used by readiness probes).

503.description: The demo state is not loaded

get.description:
Whether the LLM served on OpenShift AI answers, as checked by the AI service.

503 with ok=false when the model, the AI service or agent mode (INTERNAL_TOKEN) is missing.
Statement lines the owner already has (booked before the demo's "today"), oldest first.

post.description: The owner asks to move a payment. The same rules apply; protected payments are refused.
Save new rules as a DRAFT version. Nothing changes until it is activated.
While paused, everything Vero proposes needs the owner's approval.

get.description: 91-day daily forecast; `weekly=true` adds 13 weekly buckets for display.
The current forecast compared with what was actually booked in the sample year.

post.description:
Tell Vero something changed. Starts a run; poll GET /runs/{run_id}.

409 RUN_IN_PROGRESS while the agent is still working on an earlier run.

get.description: Everything the main screen needs in one call.

post.description: Approve a pending recommendation; it is executed in simulation.
Reject a pending recommendation. Nothing changes; the payment keeps its date.

get.description:
The activity log, oldest first: what the owner, the agent, the rules and the system did.
Each entry is sealed to the one before it (see AuditEntry), so the browser can verify that
nothing was changed.

What Vero expects each recurring cost to be: fixed costs (RENT, UTIL, XFER, PAY, SOC,
WTAX) from the statement and their contracts, then suppliers with today's list prices.
Metadata, pages with text blocks, values, clauses and the box of every printed value.
Vero Proof findings, by the date of what they concern (oldest first).

post.description:
The owner's one tap on a change Vero handled quietly: it leaves the digest. A finding
that is not quiet (it needs evidence or a decision) or was already acknowledged gives
NOT_PENDING.

Answers from at most 12 retrieved records, citing them. Never an error for model
trouble: without a usable model answer the matching records are listed instead.
Rebuild the demo company from the sample statement. Only when DEMO_MODE is on.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: UTC with milliseconds, exactly as hashed

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description:
One sealed line of the activity log. `hash` is the SHA-256 (hex) of
`prev_hash|seq|timestamp|actor|agent|run_id|recommendation_id|lane|execution|model|action`,
with absent values as empty text; the first entry's `prev_hash` is 64 zeros.
